About Me

A Scientist’s Rigor. A Partner’s Empathy.

Running a medical practice or leading a science-driven business is a daily juggling act—balancing high-stakes care and leadership with endless emails, compliance paperwork, and real life outside the clinic.

Before launching MRD Strategic Virtual Solutions, I built my foundation in high-precision environments: graduating with a B.S. in Biology (Major in Microbiology) from the University of the Philippines Los Baños, ensuring strict standards as a Microbiologist & Quality Assurance Analyst at Coca-Cola Philippines, and leading initiatives as an R&D Project Manager at Pilipinas Shell Foundation Inc.

Today, I combine that scientific discipline with hands-on operations management to serve as a calm, dependable second pair of hands—so your systems stay organized, your writing stays accurate, and your after-hours stay yours.

“True relief is handing off a project and knowing it’s in capable, caring hands.”

Medical Training & Compliance Documentation

The Challenge

Our Approach

Standardized reporting templates, cross-checked participant records for accuracy, and compiled clean post-activity summaries ready for hospital leadership review.

Key Deliverables

Formatted post-training reports, compliance checklists, and archived digital documentation packages.
